image_description: A side-profile view of a bison standing on a paved surface. The image captures the head, prominent shoulder hump, and forequarters in detail. The hindquarters are partially visible but fade out of frame or focus. The fur appears thick and shaggy, particularly around the head and shoulders, with a lighter, possibly snow-dusted or frosted appearance on the top of the head/hump.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile. It is large and broad relative to the neck. A short, dark, curved horn is visible on the near side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison's beard.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, though partially obscured by fur.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the ear region is covered by the thick fur of the head, consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder hump is very prominent and high, creating the characteristic massive silhouette of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur is visibly shaggy and dark brown/black on the forequarters and hump. There is some white/grey texture on top which may be frost or lighting, but the base fur matches.
The hindquarters are largely out of frame or blurred in the background. Cannot definitively judge fur density compared to forequarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is short and curved, small relative to the massive head and body.
The legs are visible down to the lower joint, but the feet/hooves are cut off by the bottom edge of the image or obscured by the ground/shadow. Cloven nature cannot be verified.
The rear of the animal is not fully visible; the tail is not in the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Top of head and shoulder hump
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a patch of white/grey textured material on the top of the head and hump that looks like frost or snow. However, the texture appears slightly 'painted on' or inconsistent with the surrounding fur directionality, suggesting potential AI generation artifacting or over-sharpening.

Significant depth-of-field blur is applied. While this can be photographic, the transition between the sharp foreground fur and the blurred background has slight haloing/bleeding, typical of AI generation.
The anatomy of the front leg knee/joint area is somewhat indistinct due to heavy fur, but the structural line seems slightly ambiguous. Not severe, but worth noting.

To verify the structural integrity of the visible limbs and head-neck connection, ensuring no extra limbs or warped anatomy.
